title: 第七章 神谕灵现世拒做亲传弟子第八章 入内门接比武任务日常投喂开启
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 杨卤把手放进凹槽的那一刻，广场上所有人的目光都集中到了他身上。
围观弟子们交头接耳，脸上写满了幸灾乐祸。
“等着看吧，这人肯定天赋垃圾，就靠那戒指硬撑。”
“没错，真要是有天赋，早被大宗门抢走了，还轮到咱们星澜宗？”
“我赌他最多中根骨，橙色光。”
“我赌下根骨，黄色，不能再多了。”
候景站在一旁，也是双手背在身后，面无表情地看着杨卤。他虽然觉得眼前这个年轻人有些古怪，但从修为来看，二星灵王入灵境，散修出身，天赋估计也就那样。
他心中已经有了打算——如果杨卤测出来是中根骨以下，就扔到外门做杂役弟子，让那些守门弟子出口气，也算给宗门弟子一个交代。
杨卤闭上眼睛，沉心静气。
他体内那五颗被压制的星核微微一颤，一股精纯的星力顺着手臂注入到石台之中。
石台没有反应。
广场上一片安静。
围观弟子们面面相觑，有人忍不住笑出声来：“哈哈哈，我就说吧，天赋差到连测试台都懒得反应了！”
候景眉头微皱，正要开口，突然——
轰！
石台上的符文猛地亮起，一道刺目的金色光芒冲天而起，直贯云霄！
那光芒浓烈得像是实质一般，在广场上空炸开，化作一片金色光幕，笼罩了整个星澜宗上空！
所有人都愣住了。
“这……这是什么光芒？”
“金色？不对，金色只是开始！”
话音未落，那金色光芒猛地转红，化作赤炎般的光柱！
赤炎又转橙，橙光如霞光铺洒！
橙又转黄，黄光厚重如山！
紧接着——
绿！
青！
蓝！
六色光芒交替变换，每一次变换都让整个广场的弟子心头一颤！
最后，蓝色光芒猛地收缩，然后——
一道浓郁的紫色光芒从石台中爆发出来，如同一条紫色巨龙冲天而起，带着威严和磅礴的气息，将整座星澜宗尽数笼罩！
紫色！
神谕灵！
广场上，鸦雀无声。
所有弟子全都张大了嘴巴，瞪圆了眼睛，看着那道冲天紫光，脑子里一片空白。
就连候景，这位见多识广的三星灵尊长老，此刻也彻底愣住了。他看着那紫色光柱，嘴唇微微颤抖，半晌才挤出几个字：“神……神谕灵？”
紫色，七种天赋最顶级的颜色。
神谕灵，世间最顶尖的修炼天赋，千年难得一遇的绝世天才！
content_en:
The moment Yang Lu put his hand into the groove, everyone's eyes in the square focused on him.
The onlookers were whispering to each other, with gloating written all over their faces.
"Just wait and see, this guy must have rubbish talent, he just relies on that ring to hold on."
"That's right. If you really had talent, it would have been snatched away by the big sects long ago. How about it be our Xinglan Sect's turn?"
"I bet he has the most middle bones, orange light."
"I bet a bone, yellow, no more."
Hou Jing stood aside, with his hands behind his back, looking at Yang Lu expressionlessly. Although he felt that the young man in front of him was a bit weird, judging from his cultivation level, the two-star spirit king entered the spiritual realm and was born as a casual cultivator, so his talent was probably about the same.
He already had a plan in mind - if Yang Lu was found to be below the middle bone, he would be thrown into the outer sect as a handyman disciple, so that the gatekeeper disciples could vent their anger and give an explanation to the sect disciples.
Yang Lu closed his eyes and calmed down.
The five suppressed star cores in his body trembled slightly, and a stream of pure star power poured into the stone platform along his arm.
Shitai didn't respond.
The square was quiet.
The disciples onlookers looked at each other in confusion, and some couldn't help but laugh out loud: "Hahaha, let me just say, your talent is so poor that you don't even bother to react on the test bench!"
Hou Jing frowned slightly and was about to speak when suddenly——
Boom!
The runes on the stone platform suddenly lit up, and a dazzling golden light rose into the sky and penetrated into the sky!
The light was so intense that it seemed like substance. It exploded over the square and turned into a golden light curtain, covering the sky above the entire Xinglan Sect!
Everyone was stunned.
"This... what kind of light is this?"
"Gold? No, gold is just the beginning!"
Before he finished speaking, the golden light suddenly turned red and turned into a pillar of light like red flames!
The red flame turns to orange again, and the orange light spreads like rays of sunshine!
The orange turns to yellow again, and the yellow light is as thick as a mountain!
Immediately afterwards——
Green!
green!
blue!
The six colors of light alternately change, and each change makes the hearts of the disciples in the entire square tremble!
Finally, the blue light shrank suddenly, and then——
A rich purple light burst out from the stone platform, rising into the sky like a giant purple dragon, enveloping the entire Xinglan Sect with its majestic and majestic aura!
Purple!
Oracle spirit!
There was silence in the square.
All the disciples opened their mouths and widened their eyes, looking at the purple light soaring into the sky, their minds went blank.
Even Hou Jing, the well-informed elder of the Three Star Spirit Master, was completely stunned at this moment. He looked at the purple beam of light, his lips trembled slightly, and it took him a while to squeeze out a few words: "God...oracle spirit?"
Purple, the top color among the seven talents.
Oracle Spirit, the world's top cultivation talent, a peerless genius that is rare to see in a thousand years!
title_en: Chapter 7: The oracle spirit appears in this world and refuses to be a direct disciple. Chapter 8: Entering the inner gate to receive the competition task and daily feeding begins.
